rows.finding: INSPIRE Index Polygons contains locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales.
INSPIRE is a subset of HM Land Registry's index polygons for freehold land and property, not the complete freehold-and-leasehold index.
INSPIRE data is divided into separate GML files for each local authority.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files and must be deduplicated by identifier and geometry.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
One registered title can contain several separate polygons.
Each polygon belonging to the same title has its own separate Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
The full extent of land in a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE Index Polygons.
The individual title plan is required to identify the title's general registered extent.
Absence of an INSPIRE ID may mean the property is leasehold or another tenure not present in INSPIRE, rather than unregistered.
Official Companies House charge descriptions call TGL419520 a leasehold property on the north side of Choats Road.
Exact text TGL419520 is no longer required or expected in the freehold-only INSPIRE GML.
MapSearch can obtain title numbers and distinguish freehold from leasehold tenure for registered land.
A Search of the Index Map is the official route when a property does not appear in a normal register search.
A title plan shows location and general boundaries; it normally does not establish exact legal boundaries.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are updated on the first Sunday of each month.
Each monthly INSPIRE release contains data from the previous month and remains available until the next release.
The current download page states that the active INSPIRE files were published on 5 July 2026.
INSPIRE files are published in Geography Markup Language format.
HM Land Registry states that GIS software is needed to view and work with the downloaded polygons.
HM Land Registry GML geometry is captured against British National Grid, EPSG:27700.
Reprojecting British National Grid geometry to WGS84 can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
INSPIRE geometry is reusable under the Open Government Licence with HM Land Registry and Ordnance Survey attribution requirements.
The UK-companies property dataset contains title number, freehold-or-leasehold tenure and company registration number, but requires an account and licence agreement.
The current permit point E548335 N182947 may shortlist nearby freehold INSPIRE polygons, but proximity cannot assign leasehold title TGL419520.
No freehold INSPIRE candidate can become a parcel binding until leasehold title identity and title-plan evidence are separately verified.
The current installation-register page provides separate areas for permit and compliance documents when files are available.
The register instructs users to request a document when the required permit or CAR file is absent from the download table.
The register states that installation CAR forms are currently published only from 18 August 2025 onward.
Installation permits can be searched by permit-holder name.
Installation permits can be searched by permit number.
Installation permits can be filtered by local authority.
Installation permits can be searched with complete or partial address details.
A postcode is required for register distance searches.
The register offers a one-kilometre postcode search radius.
The register offers a three-kilometre postcode search radius.
The register offers a five-kilometre postcode search radius.
The register offers a ten-kilometre postcode search radius.
Search results can be filtered to permits with published permit documents.
Search results can be filtered to permits with published CAR forms.

correction.previous_assumption: Exact leasehold title TGL419520 should occur in the INSPIRE GML.
correction.corrected_rule: INSPIRE is freehold-only and exposes INSPIRE polygon IDs; use proximity only, then verify leasehold title through MapSearch, Search of the Index Map, CCOD or title-plan evidence.

quality_gate: No INSPIRE proximity candidate is labelled TGL419520. No title, parcel or emission binding is published without separate leasehold title evidence and explicit geometry review.
